overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the notice topic "Cultch permit update" was specific enough to cover a discussion of expanding cultching, and the AG declined to review the meeting-packet complaint.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged the May 6 meeting notice topic 'Cultch permit update' was not sufficiently specific to inform the public of the discussion.
allegations.key_passage: We find that the topic “Cultch permit update” was sufficiently specific to inform the public that the Board would discuss cultching, including possibly the expansion of cultching, at the Board’s May 6 meeting.

allegations.summary: Complaint alleged a document or PowerPoint used at the May 6 meeting was left out of the meeting packet posted before the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: The Open Meeting Law does not require that a public body provide a meeting packet to any individual prior to the meeting.
